title: Slovakian Dumplings with Dough
description: A traditional Slovakian dish featuring unique, pillowy dumplings served with a side of homemade dough. Enjoy as a hearty snack or light lunch.
instructions: Combine flour and water in a bowl to form a dough.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of slovakian cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-circle.
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
Heat a large pot of water and bring to a boil.
Gently add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10 minutes, or until they float to the surface.
Serve the dumplings with a side of melted butter.
